proposedChanges.description: Set the public About description and docs homepage, and remove the unused Wiki entry point.

body.description: Android-first, self-hosted control for local pi sessions.

proposedChanges.description: Add bounded product and implementation discovery topics.
Enable the intended GitHub private security-reporting channel; keep the detail-free public fallback.
Enable Dependabot vulnerability alerts for the repository dependency graphs.
Allow Dependabot security-update pull requests without enabling auto-merge.

explicitNoChange.pagesDomain: Keep the existing github.io URL; do not set a custom domain or CNAME.
explicitNoChange.mainRuleset: Keep the active signed, linear, strict 12-context ruleset unchanged.
explicitNoChange.mergeMethods: Keep merge commits disabled and squash/rebase enabled.
explicitNoChange.issuesProjectsDiscussions: Keep Issues and Projects enabled and Discussions disabled.
explicitNoChange.secretScanning: Keep secret scanning and push protection enabled; do not change unreviewed optional scanners.
explicitNoChange.releasesTagsAssets: Do not edit releases, tags, assets, Latest identity, or prerelease state.
explicitNoChange.securityFallback: Keep the detail-free public fallback even after PVR is enabled.

preconditions: Obtain explicit authorization naming the exact proposedChanges IDs to apply.
Re-read every current value and stop on drift instead of overwriting it.
Apply only after the project-surface branch has passed required external checks and is the intended source state.
Do not send vulnerability details, credentials, pairing URLs, auth headers, keys, or private code through the public fallback.
postconditions: GET /repos/jczhang02/lyntty matches the authorized About, Wiki, and security settings exactly.
GET /repos/jczhang02/lyntty/topics returns exactly the authorized topic set.
GET /repos/jczhang02/lyntty/private-vulnerability-reporting returns enabled=true if that change was authorized.
GET /repos/jczhang02/lyntty/vulnerability-alerts returns HTTP 204 if that change was authorized.
Pages remains workflow-backed at https://jczhang02.github.io/lyntty/ with cname=null and HTTPS enforced.
Ruleset 18673628 remains active with the same 12 strict required contexts, signatures, and linear history.
Record before/after responses and mutation authorization in a separate evidence update.
